modules.name: organizations-and-people
modules.purpose: Identify organizations and people while separating durable identity from time-bounded claims about them.

modules.name: products-and-commerce
modules.purpose: Represent named commercial offerings and their time-varying product facts.

modules.name: diagnostics-and-biomarkers
modules.purpose: Represent laboratory tests, panels, measured biomarkers, reported metrics, and enabling assay platforms.

modules.name: studies-and-evidence
modules.purpose: Represent research studies and bounded evidence-bearing claims.

modules.name: documents-and-provenance
modules.purpose: Preserve source documents and addressable source excerpts used to support extracted knowledge.

node:Organization.description: A durable legal, commercial, academic, or other organized actor, such as TruDiagnostic.
node:Organization.identity_semantics: Use for the durable actor identity; place changing descriptions and business facts on OrganizationSnapshot.
common_confusions: Do not model a branded test sold by the organization as the Organization itself.

node:OrganizationSnapshot.description: A time-bounded description of an organization, including changing business, positioning, and operational facts.
node:OrganizationSnapshot.temporal_role: Use the snapshot validity interval for claims that may change while retaining Organization as stable identity.

node:Person.description: A durable human identity, such as a founder, executive, investigator, or author.
node:Person.identity_semantics: Resolve a person independently of their changing roles and affiliations.

node:Product.description: A durable named product or commercial offering identity, including a branded diagnostic product.
node:Product.identity_semantics: Use for TruAge, TruHealth, and other stable branded product identities; use LabTest for the laboratory test delivered by a product.
common_confusions: A Product can deliver a LabTest but is not interchangeable with that test definition.

node:ProductSnapshot.description: A time-bounded state of a product, such as current description, availability, formulation, or commercial positioning.
node:ProductSnapshot.temporal_role: Capture mutable product facts without changing the durable Product identity.

node:LabTest.description: A laboratory analysis that accepts specimens and produces one or more measured or computed results.
node:LabTest.identity_semantics: Model the analytical test independently from the commercial Product that delivers it.
common_confusions: Do not substitute Product when the report describes the underlying laboratory analysis.

node:PanelDefinition.description: A named, reusable grouping that defines which lab tests or biomarkers belong to a diagnostic panel.
node:PanelDefinition.identity_semantics: Use for panel composition, not for an individual observed result.

node:Biomarker.description: A biological characteristic or signal that a test measures, derives, or interprets.

node:Metric.description: A defined reported measure or score, including computed aging-clock outputs such as DunedinPACE.
node:Metric.identity_semantics: Use for a reusable metric definition, not a subject-specific observed value.

node:TechnologyPlatform.description: An analytical or computational platform used to perform, implement, or support a test.
common_confusions: A platform enables a test but is not the LabTest or Product.

node:Study.description: A bounded research investigation, validation study, clinical study, or other systematic inquiry.

node:Claim.description: A bounded proposition extracted from or supported by evidence, kept distinct from established graph identity facts.
node:Claim.provenance_role: Connect the proposition to its supporting source locations and preserve qualification or uncertainty.

node:Document.description: A source artifact such as a webpage, paper, report, or product page from which evidence was acquired.
node:Document.provenance_role: Retain source identity, URL, and acquisition-level metadata; use Chunk for addressable excerpts.

node:Chunk.description: An addressable excerpt or segment of a source Document used for retrieval and evidence localization.
node:Chunk.provenance_role: Provide fine-grained evidence location beneath a Document; do not treat the excerpt as a durable domain entity.
